body: Reproduced. Root cause is fetchsize=10000 with no query partitioning.
Fix: add numPartitions + partitionColumn options to JDBC read.
Started dedup logic. Using row_number() over partition by PK.
Found the bug — refresh token is not being stored in secure storage.
Cannot reproduce on iOS 17. Likely iOS 16 specific.
Going with sliding window counter stored in Redis.
All schemas reviewed and merged. ingestion_date added as partition col.
/health should always be excluded from rate limits by convention.
